text: The dentist here is excellent and explains things very clearly. I decided to get my clear retainers here even though I didn't get braces here. I regret finding this clinic so late; otherwise, I would have gotten braces here too. I received my retainers very quickly, in just 3 days! The dentist is very gentle; the tartar removal was painless. If you're afraid of tartar removal, I highly recommend this clinic. The front desk staff are very helpful and attentive to patients. They even gave me a tool to remove my long nails because they noticed I had my nails done and were worried I wouldn't be able to take the retainers off – so thoughtful! The clinic is large, clean, and spacious with plenty of waiting area seating, snacks, and coffee. There's ample parking and it's easy to get to. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, you won't be disappointed. I highly recommend this one!
